tweets.text:
Whale risk isn't a mystery you have to sense from price action, it's data sitting in the open. Most of the times.

Unlock schedules, holder concentration, how much supply sits in the top handful of wallets, none of that is hidden. Most people never check any of it before sizing into a position.

The assets that hold up best over time usually have this in common. Supply that started concentrated in a few hands slowly spreads out across more holders. Fewer wallets left that can move price on their own.
